title: Post draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 to datatracker (IETF 127 week)
description:
Post draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 to the IETF datatracker before the jmap@ email (jmap-chat-spec-0577) goes out. Target Monday 2026-11-16, IETF 127 week; I-D submission normally reopens when meeting week starts, so check first.

Steps: build the XML with kramdown-rfc, check it with xml2rfc and idnits, then upload at https://datatracker.ietf.org/submit/ as mark@reviewcommit.com. Posting is public and outward-facing, so it needs Mark's explicit go-ahead. After posting, check that https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-atwood-jmap-updates/ resolves, and update 0577 if the URL differs.

Note: this is the first draft in the corpus with category std and submissiontype IETF; the others are exp and independent. That fits a document that updates RFC 8620 and RFC 9425.
